_comment: Closed class of Bulgarian function words that are USUALLY UNSTRESSED (proclitics/enclitics). mark_chitanka_text.py gives these an explicit all-unstressed label (zeros in the Accentor's per-vowel BCE) instead of masking them as OOV. DRAFTED BY CLAUDE 2026-07-04 — needs native vetting. Deliberately EXCLUDED because the same surface has a stressed reading: ти/те/то (subject pronoun vs clitic), край (preposition vs noun кра́й), ако/дали/нито/срещу/против (carry their own stress), аз/той/тя (stressed pronouns). CAUTION: не can take emphatic stress in speech; kept here because in written prose the unstressed proclitic reading dominates — revisit if the human-speech branches show it matters.
